verdict.rationale: The evidence documents official web client SDKs, daily-js and Daily React, plus a server-side REST API for rooms and tokens that could act as a shared backend. Nothing in the pack shows native iOS or Android SDKs, or a shared session and track model across platforms. missing for 10: evidence of official iOS SDK, official Android SDK, documentation of a consistent session/track model across platforms, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: Full control over your call UI with daily-js, or use Daily React for a hooks-based React experience.
Create rooms, manage tokens, trigger recordings, and control calls from your server.
